status: Fixed in source-first hook routing and WIP recovery lane
finding: `node atm.dev.mjs tasks release --wip-commit` can reach an inner `git commit`, but Git still invokes the installed pre-commit hook through frozen `node atm.mjs hook pre-commit`. evidenceOrRepro: ATM-GOV-0258 WIP park attempts: frozen `tasks release --wip-commit` returned ATM_CLI_USAGE; source-first release after lane adopt failed inside git commit because frozen pre-commit emitted ATM_TOUCHED_PHYSICAL_LINE_BUDGET_BLOCKED. followUp: Source repair is verified. The historical frozen-runner failure remains incident context only; retain the source-first runner-selection and WIP commit regression coverage. Frozen publication and formal governance closeout are separate from this backlog status.
